title: A Taxonomy of Runtime Faults in Model Context Protocol Servers
abstract: arXiv:2606.05339v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: MCP (Model Context Protocol) enables LLMs (Large Language Models) to interact with external tools and data sources via a standardized protocol. Its rapid adoption in tool-augmented Artificial Intelligence (AI) workflows has introduced new reliability challenges, such as configuration parameters that are accepted but not enforced at runtime, leading to unintended default behavior, whose runtime fault characteristics remain empirically unexamined. We present the first empirical taxonomy of runtime faults in MCP servers. We manually analyzed 833 confirmed runtime fault threads identified through a repository-mining pipeline covering 473 actively maintained MCP server GitHub repositories and derived a taxonomy using a bottom-up open coding procedure. translated_title: 模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器运行时故障的分类体系
translated_abstract: MCP（模型上下文协议）使大语言模型（LLM）能够通过标准化协议与外部工具和数据源进行交互。它在工具增强的人工智能（AI）工作流中的快速普及带来了新的可靠性挑战，例如配置参数虽被接受但在运行时未被强制执行，从而导致意外的默认行为，而其运行时故障特征此前尚未得到实证检验。我们提出了首个MCP服务器运行时故障的实证分类体系。我们通过一个覆盖473个活跃维护的MCP服务器GitHub仓库的仓库挖掘流水线，手动分析了833个已确认的运行时故障讨论线程，并采用自下而上的开放编码方法推导出该分类体系。该分类体系包含11个顶层类别和27个子类别（73种叶子故障类型），涵盖了协议交互、工具调用、模式强制执行、状态管理等方面反复出现的故障。
tldr: 本文通过对473个活跃MCP服务器GitHub仓库中833个已确认运行时故障线程的实证分析，首次构建了包含11个顶层类别、27个子类别（73种叶子故障类型）的MCP服务器运行时故障分类体系。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical taxonomy of runtime faults in MCP servers, derived from manual analysis of 833 confirmed fault threads across 473 actively maintained GitHub repositories, comprising 11 top-level categories and 27 subcategories (73 leaf fault types).
